Regarding the Statement of Allah, Blessed and Exalted: 'And give good tidings to those who believe that they have a lofty rank of truth before their Lord,' he said: 'It is the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).'

key_terms.عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ: Before their Lord / In the presence of their Lord
key_terms.قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ: Lofty rank of truth / Steadfast position of truth

ai.seo_question: What does the Quranic term 'Qadam Sidq' refer to according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the 'Qadam Sidq' (Foot/Station of Truth) in Surah Yunus as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), emphasizing his supreme spiritual rank. This interpretation aligns with the Shia exegetical tradition where 'Sidq' denotes the ultimate truthfulness and authority of the Prophet, serving as the foundation for the Imams' own station of truth. The hadith underscores the theological significance of the Prophet's role as the primary bearer of divine truth and the model for subsequent infallible leaders.
